label: home port; where the debt, the licence and the retirement all sit
notes: Born here; her firm's debt held here against the wagons, her tile stamped here, her retirement owed here by an Assembly counting-house on the quay. Chapter 1 assembles the crossing on these stepped quays with the harrow bell rung once per wagon out. Everything she stands to lose is in one town, which is why the plain feels safer to her than the rim does.
